findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 8 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 19 questions numbered 1-19; by section: 8.1.1 1, 8.2 1, 8.3.2 2, 8.3.3 3, 8.3.4 4, 8.4.1 4, 8.5.1 1, 8.5.2 1, 8.5.3 1, 8.5.4 1.

19 five-mark questions: the LRT with intervals of sign change, the graphical method, full Bisection, Regula-Falsi and Newton-Raphson solutions (2 and 3 decimal places), the Newton-Raphson square-root formula, the derivation of the Trapezium Rule and three trapezium estimates compared with exact values, and the four kinds of 8.5 applications, all with new functions. Book corrections followed: stop only when |f(c)| < 0.005 for two places (0.0005 for three), open interval ]a, b[ in the LRT. Intermediate values to 4 decimal places; every step and each final rounding (sign test at r +/- half a unit) was checked by computation (check8.py).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
